original_requirement: Materialize one independent, inert PA-STRICT-TOOL-OBS-1 approval package for a future real-provider observation without executing it or changing production behavior.
operational_definition: Generate a hash-bound Plan, disabled Approval Candidate, non-authorizing patch template, validate-only receipt and do-not-execute preview for exactly review/planning_adaptation_whole_receipt/planning_adaptation_whole@1/review/configured_fallback.
forbidden_narrowing: Materialization success cannot be presented as real-provider evidence.
A disabled candidate or patch template cannot be presented as user authorization.
A missing provider snapshot cannot be presented as zero tool calls.
Observation success cannot be presented as workflow completion.
The budget candidate cannot be presented as a Runtime budget change.
closed_world_justification: The target is a six-field equality tuple and the only changed code is Canary control-plane tooling; production Runtime sources are protected.

constraint_traceability.requirement: All external actions remain disabled during materialization.

constraint_traceability.evidence: Tests fail on credential lookup and assert network/model/paid counters remain zero.

constraint_traceability.implementation: The materializer recomputes every definition from current local production metadata and canonical schemas.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Validate-only independently regenerates the base plan and compares every bound digest.

constraint_traceability.implementation: Only metadata is copied to a temporary DB, before/after parity is exact, and generated documents receive a closed privacy scan.

model_output_not_applicable_evidence: No file under src/novel_flywheel is modified; no Prompt, request, parser, adapter, validator, route, retry/fallback, output budget or acceptance code changes.
why_previous_tests_missed: R1-PA1 stopped at an unapproved draft and intentionally did not materialize current fingerprints, a single-use cohort, candidate, patch template or validate-only receipt.
